title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Not a single retweet of Tigers tweets from Freep accounts
Lol sometimes. I don’t really pay attention. Just looking for a way to say I’m annoyed by whoever runs the accounts
Mainly was hoping Manzuillo was working tonight so I could roast him
Not from an account, just mock him behind his back with you.
I’ve never met the guy but I don’t like him
Liked “Not from an account, just mock him behind his back with you.”
Of course we went with the unoriginal “One Detroit team drafted a Super Bowl winning QB lololol”
